description: Fixed ChatBI NL2SQL acceptance set. Model accuracy is based on executed-result equivalence; policy cases are reported separately.

cases.question: 2024年已支付订单一共有多少单，销售额合计多少元？
cases.referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS paid_orders, SUM(total_amount) AS paid_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01'

cases.question: 2024年各种订单状态分别有多少单？
cases.referenceSql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY status

cases.question: 按月统计2024年已支付订单的销售额趋势。

referenceSql.mysql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS paid_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
referenceSql.postgresql: SELECT TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS paid_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month

cases.question: 2024年线上和线下渠道的已支付销售额分别是多少？
cases.referenceSql: SELECT channel, SUM(total_amount) AS paid_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY channel

cases.question: 各大区分别有多少客户？
cases.referenceSql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY region

cases.question: 每个产品类目有多少种产品？
cases.referenceSql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category

cases.question: 按目录销售单价列出最贵的5个产品及价格。
cases.referenceSql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: 2024年已支付订单的平均客单价是多少？
cases.referenceSql: SELECT AVG(total_amount) AS average_paid_order_value FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01'

cases.question: 2024年各大区的已支付订单销售额分别是多少？
cases.referenceSql: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.total_amount) AS paid_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.region

cases.question: 2024年已支付订单中，各产品类目的成交金额分别是多少？
cases.referenceSql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.amount) AS paid_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.category

cases.question: 2024年VIP客户贡献的已支付订单销售额是多少？
cases.referenceSql: SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) AS vip_paid_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND c.level = 'VIP' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'

cases.question: 2024年各大区的已支付订单数是多少？
cases.referenceSql: SELECT c.region, COUNT(*) AS paid_order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.region

cases.question: 只保留华东这一行，保持上一轮的指标和大区维度，不要按城市拆分。
cases.referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS paid_order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND c.region = '华东' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'

cases.question: 2024年退款订单有多少单，退款订单金额合计多少元？
cases.referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS refunded_orders, SUM(total_amount) AS refunded_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'refunded' AND order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01'

cases.question: 2024年各城市的已支付订单数分别是多少？
cases.referenceSql: SELECT c.city, COUNT(*) AS paid_order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.city

cases.question: 2024年已支付订单中，各产品类目的成交件数是多少？
cases.referenceSql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS paid_quantity FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.category

cases.question: 列出2024年已支付销售额最高的3位客户及其金额。
cases.referenceSql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS paid_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY paid_amount DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: VIP和普通客户分别有多少人？
cases.referenceSql: SELECT level, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY level

cases.question: 2024年线上渠道已支付订单的平均客单价是多少？
cases.referenceSql: SELECT AVG(total_amount) AS average_order_value FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND channel = '线上' AND order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01'

cases.question: 2024年各渠道待支付订单的数量和金额分别是多少？
cases.referenceSql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS pending_orders, SUM(total_amount) AS pending_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' AND order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY channel

cases.question: 2024年至少有一笔已支付订单的客户共有多少位？
cases.referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS paid_customer_count FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01'

cases.question: 列出2024年已支付订单中成交件数最多的5个产品名称和成交件数。
cases.referenceSql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS paid_quantity FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY paid_quantity DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: 按目录销售单价减成本价，列出单位毛利最高的5个产品及单位毛利。
cases.referenceSql: SELECT name, price - cost AS unit_gross_profit FROM products ORDER BY unit_gross_profit DESC LIMIT 5
